title: Spherical Plancherel-Godement decomposition for a unimodular locally compact quantum group with compact closed subgroup, type I spherical dual and separable spherical and full universal dual C star algebras
author: Martijn Caspers
source_title: Spherical Fourier Transforms on Locally Compact Quantum Gelfand Pairs
difficulty_reason: A spherical projection alone does not identify the correct measure, positive unbounded operators or corepresentation multiplicities. The author establishes the spherical weight and its exact GNS core, induces representations through a Hilbert module, and identifies the supported spectrum with irreducible corepresentations having subgroup-invariant vectors. Measurable-field and densely defined operator arguments then extend the invariant-vector transform to an intertwining unitary on the full spherical cyclic space.
source_version: Official SIGMA 7 (2011) article 087, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2011.087; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.note: Read exactTheorem7.1(1)-(4), full main proof of those parts, modular invariant-projection Proposition3.16, dense/semifinite weight and GNS arguments4.1-4.7, complete Hilbert-module induction6.1 and spherical-spectrum correspondence, and measurable-field/intertwiner Propositions5.9/5.10. Desmedt approximate-KMS-weight Plancherel theorem, Hilbert-module induction foundation and standard measurable-direct-integral/operator closure facts are explicit published prerequisites. The new spherical weight core, induction identification, weak-containment support and extension from invariant vectors to the full cyclic space are authored. The optional restriction statement(5), classical one-dimensional specializations and concrete SUq example are excluded from counting. Exact selected statement and terminal proof pages rendered and visually inspected; all physical header/native ZIP members and source/license hashes checked. Scope and author routine-detail wording preserved; no independent mathematical reproof.

statement_scope: Theorem7.1 properties(1)-(4): (M,Delta) is a unimodular locally compact quantum group, (M1,Delta1) a compact closed quantum subgroup, the original spherical dual vonNeumann algebra Nhat is typeI, and the original spherical universal dual Nhat_u and full universal dual Mhat_u are separable. There exist the source standard measure on irreducible corepresentations with invariant vectors, measurable full/invariant Hilbert fields, strictly positive self-adjoint operators on invariant fibers, and the specified spherical Plancherel-Godement unitary on E. Its invariant restriction satisfies the original Hilbert-Schmidt trace isometry and intertwines the spherical dual, while the extension intertwines the restricted multiplicative unitary. Preserve the exact spaces E,I_N,closures and operator-domain conventions from Sections3-7. No dual-Mhat typeI assumption or optional property(5) is asserted.
editorial_warning: The spherical dual is assumed typeI, but need not be Abelian; no one-dimensional invariant-fiber assertion is selected. Self-adjoint operator inverses and products use the original closure conventions. The full measurable-field/domain context is supplied; no arbitrary formal trace reinterpretation added.
